eligibility_rule.definition: Include an event if and only if the official Binance BTCUSDT spot 5-minute path contains exactly 144 unique timestamps from 20:00 UTC inclusive to 08:00 UTC exclusive, with required archives downloaded and parsed and every predeclared event-day SHA-256 matching.
eligibility_rule.exclusion_reason: 18 absent official 5-minute intervals from 2021-03-06T02:00:00Z through 03:25:00Z; no market outcome or P2 test was inspected to make this decision.

path_data.integrity: exact 144 timestamps; stop on any additional incomplete path or hash mismatch

primary_tests.gate: negative direction in at least four evaluable years, calendar-month block bootstrap 95% CI below zero, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05

primary_tests.outcome: cause-specific first passage to counter_excursion_fraction >= 0.25 by 12h
primary_tests.expected: one-SD higher P2_score reduces counter-passage hazard
primary_tests.model: one-parameter Cox model stratified by year with Breslow ties
primary_tests.gate: hazard ratio < 1 in at least four evaluable years, calendar-month block bootstrap 95% CI below 1, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05

secondary_outputs: first passage to fixed fractions 0.10, 0.50 and 1.00 with separate Holm correction
maximum counter and aligned excursions at H1/H3/H6/H12
multiprocess_guardrail: P2 is only one possible temporal state. No result can establish a universal route, replace the other mechanisms, authorize a global directional classifier, or authorize trading.
